# Gaby's House Cleaning

> Family-owned house cleaning company in Caldwell, Idaho, owned by Gabriela (Gaby) and Roberto Lopez since 2024. Licensed and insured. 5.0 stars from 8 Google reviews.

- Phone: (208) 391-0310 (call or text)
- Email: gabyshousecleaningllc@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 6pm, Saturday 9am to 3pm
- Service area: Caldwell, Nampa, Middleton, Meridian, Boise, Kuna, Eagle, Garden City and Star, Idaho (Treasure Valley, Canyon and Ada County)
- Services: regular house cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in and move-out cleaning, post-construction cleaning, commercial and office cleaning
- Quotes are free. Supplies are included.
